It does not say what happens when the flag is still set. A removed flag might be silently ignored (setting-ignored), or it might stop Loki from starting (workload-failure). The proposal's claim that the flag "will be ignored" is a guess the excerpt doesn't support, and the excerpt doesn't support any other kind either. To decide, we need the surrounding text of that upgrade-guide section, or the release notes, saying what happens to configurations that still pass this flag.
